limitations_and_boundaries: GBC detection efficiency is lower in BMDCs (60%) compared to K562 cells (94-98%), attributed to lower transcript complexity of BMDCs.
The linear model assumes additive effects and may not capture all nonlinearities; genetic interaction analysis is limited to pairs with sufficient double-infected cells.

Downsampling analysis suggests that tens of cells per perturbation may suffice for cell-state level analysis, but genome-wide or high-order combinatorial screens face exponential scaling of combination space.
The study uses CRISPR/Cas9 knockout; complementary approach (CRISPRi) is covered in a companion paper (Adamson et al., 2016).

research_questions.statement: How can pooled genetic screens with single-cell RNA-seq readout (Perturb-seq) dissect transcriptional effects of perturbations on genes, programs, and cell states?

provenance.text_excerpt: For each pair of perturbed TFs, we assessed the relative proportion of target genes where their relation is additive (no interaction), synergistic, buffering (antagonistic), or dominant...

claims.statement: Genetic interactions between TF pairs are non-additive and can be categorized as additive, synergistic, buffering, or dominant, with binding co-occupancy associated with dominant interactions.

provenance.text_excerpt: cells perturbed in EGR1 are depleted from cell-state 6, which has an increased expression of hemoglobin biosynthesis genes, consistent with EGR1's known role... Cells perturbed in YY1 are enriched in state 5 (induction of cholesterol biosynthesis genes), consistent with its known role as a repressor of this process

claims.statement: K562 TF perturbations reveal reproducible gene-specific effects and cell-state enrichments consistent with known functions (e.g., EGR1 in hemoglobin, YY1 in cholesterol).

provenance.text_excerpt: We developed Perturb-seq, a method to analyze the transcriptional effect associated with genetic manipulations on genes, processes, and states.

claims.statement: Perturb-seq enables pooled CRISPR screens with single-cell RNA-seq readout to dissect transcriptional effects of perturbations on genes, programs, and cell states.

provenance.text_excerpt: We hypothesize that a plausible alternative strategy exists, combining substantial under-sampling of this vast space with appropriate analytics... If sparsity holds for expression phenotypes, a subset of experiments can be performed in which most cells receive a relatively large number of perturbations...

claims.statement: Perturb-seq can be scaled to genome-wide or combinatorial screens by undersampling combinatorial space, leveraging modularity and sparsity of genetic interactions.

provenance.text_excerpt: Cell states explain a significant proportion of observed variation (Figure 2D), and some of the sgRNAs' effects are accounted for (Figure 2F versus 2G), suggesting that those perturbations may have primarily affected subtype proportions.

claims.statement: Cell-cycle and cell-subtype covariates explain significant variation and reveal TF-specific effects masked by global cell-state changes.

provenance.text_excerpt: Module M2 and M4 have opposite effects on the proportion of cells in two mutually exclusive cell states, reflected by programs P2 and P4/5.

claims.statement: TF modules M2 and M4 have opposing effects on BMDC cell states via positive and negative feedback loops.

evidence_spans.content: Perturb-seq method description: pooled lentiviral CRISPR screen with expressed barcodes, scRNA-seq readout, and MIMOSCA linear model.

provenance.text_excerpt: We used a CRISPR lentiviral vector that both delivers an sgRNA to a cell and reports on the identity of the sgRNA by an expressed GBC... We devised a computational framework (MIMOSCA) based on a regularized linear model, to estimate the impact of perturbations on gene expression

experiments_or_tasks: Pooled lentiviral CRISPR/Cas9 screen with expressed guide barcodes (GBCs), followed by single-cell RNA-seq (10x Chromium) to capture transcriptomes and GBCs; cells include BMDCs from Cas9 mice and K562 cells; varying MOI to study single or combinatorial perturbations; stimulation with LPS in BMDCs at 0 and 3 hr; FACS or antibiotic selection for transduced cells.

methods.name: Perturb-seq pooled screen with GBC enrichment
methods.protocol_description: CRISPR lentiviral vector expressing sgRNA and a guide barcode (GBC); cells transduced at varying MOI; selection by FACS or puromycin; scRNA-seq with 10x Chromium; PCR enrichment of GBC following whole transcriptome amplification; filtering of low-abundance GBCs to distinguish multiple infections from PCR chimeras.

methods.name: MIMOSCA linear model
methods.protocol_description: Regularized linear model (elastic net) predicting each gene's log expression as linear combination of guide effects; includes technical covariates (number of transcripts per cell), biological covariates (cell sub-type/state from unperturbed cells), and iterative correction for perturbation success probability; can include interaction terms for genetic epistasis.
